title: macos-apps-mcp
description: Lets an AI assistant use Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Notes, Photos and five more Mac apps. A delete, move or send previews by default.
next_action: 0.16: the owner's short reply test on a real Mac (plan 05.2-20). The signed build for it is ready.
eli14: Think of the project as a restaurant kitchen. The AI assistant is the chef, and the apps on the Mac are the pantry. The house rule is safe cooking: anything that throws food away, moves it or sends it out is shown first by default, and a dish that was moved can come back. Each release adds one dish to the menu. 1.0 is the grand opening.
prose:
**How we got here.**

- **0.1–0.7 (June–July 2026): a server each client starts.** Calendar and Reminders first, then trust, safety rails and fast reads. Each client started its own copy and asked for its own permissions.
- **0.8–0.10 (July–August): one signed app.** A signed background app holds the permissions once. Mail grows to full depth, with undo, and sending waits behind a switch.
- **0.11–0.15 (September–October): the planned rebuild.** After the review of 2026-08-28, a written plan rebuilds the base, fixes Mail, deepens Calendar, Reminders, Notes and Photos, and adds the owner's dashboard.
- **0.16–1.0 (from November): road to launch.** A new MCP core, the open bugs, the final tool names, problem reports, then the testers and the public launch.
- **After 1.0:** deeper Contacts and Messages, Safari, Maps and a menu-bar app.

## Blockers

- 0.16 waits for that reply test. The fix for mails that end with a picture is merged (plan 05.2-19).

## Decisions

- Contacts and Messages depth waits for v2 (owner, 2026-08-28).
- Email work comes before every new feature (owner, 2026-09-24).
- Bugs come before features (owner, 2026-10-11).
- One release at every phase close that changes the app. 0.17 is the breaking release, and 1.0 follows the testers (owner, 2026-11-01).
- The MCP 2 migration comes first (owner, 2026-11-03).

milestones.title: Reads nine Mac apps and writes Calendar and Reminders
milestones.summary: The first release reads nine Mac apps and writes Calendar events and Reminders, with repeat rules.

milestones.title: New name: mac-mcp
milestones.summary: The project and its package take the name mac-mcp, with an MIT licence.

milestones.title: Errors that explain themselves
milestones.summary: A native failure is a typed error, doctor checks the permissions, and each create or update is read back.

milestones.title: Previews and limits before a delete
milestones.summary: Event and note deletes preview first, batches have caps, and text from the apps is marked as untrusted.

milestones.title: Reads from the apps' own databases
milestones.summary: Messages and Notes are read from their own databases, which is faster and more complete than AppleScript.

milestones.title: New name: macos-apps-mcp
milestones.summary: The package, the repository and the module take the name macos-apps-mcp.

milestones.title: Free time, Notes writes and a write log
milestones.summary: Free and busy times, Notes create and update, a log of every write, and a list of mail that needs a reply.

milestones.title: One signed app holds the permissions
milestones.summary: A signed background app asks for each Mac permission once, and every client connects through it.

milestones.title: Sending mail, behind a switch
milestones.summary: Mail can send, reply and forward, but only after the owner turns sending on outside the assistant's reach.

milestones.title: Mail complete, with undo
milestones.summary: Mail gets search, threads, folders, trash and attachments, and a backup before each move or delete makes undo possible.

milestones.title: Mail search and undo on macOS 15
milestones.summary: Mail reads its own database on macOS 15 too, so search and undo work there.

milestones.title: A rebuilt base, proven by tests
milestones.summary: One safe path to the apps, settled modules, and a test suite that cannot reach a real app.

milestones.title: Large Mail moves finish, and drafts use the right account
milestones.summary: A move of 25 messages finishes in time and leaves a receipt, and a draft starts from the account the caller names.

milestones.title: Calendar alarms, Reminders depth, Intel Macs
milestones.summary: Events get alarms and more repeat rules, Reminders can be deleted and show their tags, and the app runs on Intel Macs.

milestones.title: Photos and the owner's dashboard
milestones.summary: Photos can be searched and exported, and a local dashboard shows permissions, usage, the write log and backups.

milestones.title: Runs on MCP 2, and replies keep Mail's quote
milestones.summary: The server moves to MCP 2 and the open bugs are fixed.

items.name: Bug fixes — every open bug before Phase 6 (#455, #399, #348)
Bug fixes — Notes write safety and system folders in any language (#500, #501, #497, #471, #521, #540, #556)
Bug fixes — the app after an upgrade (#568) and two private advisories, and the 2026-11-06 review defects (#572–#581)

milestones.title: Final tool names and clear errors
milestones.summary: A breaking release before the testers: each tool name is a verb and a noun, and each error names its kind.

items.name: Tool surface — parameter descriptions, verb_noun names, merged duplicates and error codes (#514, #502)

milestones.title: Problem reports, then the testers
milestones.summary: A failing server leads the person to one redacted report, sent with their own click, and then the testers start.

items.name: Feedback — problem reports and improvement suggestions (#465)

milestones.title: Long reads continue page by page
milestones.summary: A capped read continues with a cursor that belongs to its query, and a cursor from another query is refused.

items.name: Paged reads — a cursor bound to the query (#508)

milestones.title: Tools from the command line
milestones.summary: Any tool runs from the shell through the signed background app.

milestones.title: Notes in Markdown, with attachments
milestones.summary: Notes take Markdown and show their attachments.

items.name: Notes depth — Markdown input and note attachments (#505, #506)

milestones.title: Guidance for assistants
milestones.summary: The server tells an assistant how to use it, with one short guide per app.

items.name: Agent guidance — server instructions and per-app skills (#503, #504)

milestones.title: Public launch, one-step install
milestones.summary: After the testers, it is listed for everyone and installs in one step.

Dashboard at a domain — the loader page (#483)
